preconditions.description: The size of the array arr[] is between 1 and 1000.
The length of each string in arr[] and str is between 1 and 1000.
The length k is between 1 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: arr[i], str must contain only lowercase English alphabets
preconditions.description: All characters in arr[] and str are lowercase English letters.

postconditions.expression: return_value == count of strings in arr[] whose prefix of length k matches with the k-length prefix of str
postconditions.description: The function must return the count of strings in arr[] whose prefix of length k matches with the k-length prefix of str.
